notes: Release date 2026-06-30 from the newsroom index "Jun 30, 2026 - Introducing Claude Sonnet 5"; OpenRouter created 2026-06-30 matches. Only absolute prose number is the Firefox-147 working-exploit 0.0% (safety); all capability scores are image-table/curve-only, recorded pending with vision reads in notes. Effort/cost curve charts for BrowseComp and OSWorld-Verified (chart images cd0df787 / d5c761e8) compare Sonnet 5 vs Sonnet 4.6 vs Opus 4.8 across effort levels - no numbers machine-readable. PROTOCOL-TRANSPARENCY CHANGELOG (June 30 edit): the original BrowseComp cost-performance chart used a simpler non-standard methodology that underestimated Sonnet 5; it was replaced with the system-card methodology (10M token budget, compaction, programmatic tool calling). PRICING CHANGELOG (August 10 edit): introductory USD 2/10 per MTok made permanent; the previously planned USD 3/15 from September 1 no longer applies. Safety: overall lower misaligned-behavior rate than Sonnet 4.6 but higher than Opus 4.8 and Mythos Preview (chart d018d76a); cyber safeguards enabled by default (same family as Opus 4.7/4.8, less strict than Fable 5). Available on all plans as Free/Pro default. Customer quotes carry no benchmark numbers.
